name: Lady Diana Sunblock Cream SPF UV 40 - 170ml
description:
Sunblock SPF 40 – 170ml

☀️ Broad-Spectrum Protection | Lightweight | Moisturizing

Product Type: Sunblock
Capacity: 170ml
Suitable For: Men & Women
Made in UAE (Imported)

Key Benefits:

Broad-Spectrum Protection: SPF 40 shields against harmful UVA & UVB rays that cause sunburn, premature aging & skin cancer.

Nourishing & Moisturizing: Enriched with Vitamin E to deeply hydrate, nourish & soften skin.

Lightweight & Non-Greasy: Absorbs quickly without leaving sticky residue.

Water-Resistant & Long-Lasting: Protects even during sweating or swimming.

Gentle Formula: Safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin.

Dermatologist Tested: Clinically proven for safety & effectiveness.

✅ Ideal For Daily Use – Face & Body
✅ Unisex Formula – Suitable for both Men & Women
✅ Best for Outdoor Activities – Long-lasting sun protection
